text: accel_step forms at a val_mse_ratio of 2.0-2.6 at N=64, about 2.6-3.1% of each run's step-0 value, compared with about 2% at N=16. In the paired N=256 arm, does formation also happen at about 2-3% of step-0 val MSE, even though N=256 never beats the baseline? That would tie formation to relative loss reduction rather than to a fixed training step.
